overview: Mauritius is an island country in the Indian Ocean, east of Madagascar. Its capital and largest city is Port Louis. The islands had no people until European settlement, and Mauritius became independent from the United Kingdom in 1968; it has since become one of Africa's most stable and prosperous countries. It was the only home of the dodo, which died out in the 1600s.

geography.text: The main island of Mauritius is volcanic, with a central plateau surrounded by mountains and a coast almost completely ringed by coral reefs. The country also includes the island of Rodrigues and several smaller, more remote islands.
